subject: CYCLE-2 RESULT ticket03: adversarial oracle falsified once, revised, then 100000 streams PASS with zero violations
body: Cycle 2 adversarially tested source loss, service restart, generation+host+resource replacement, reversal/terminal, late old-host callbacks, stale-source useful callbacks, wallpaper candidates, backdated receipts, and non-readiness proxies. The first research-model run falsified itself at randomized stream 593: a stale-source duplicate FIRST_USEFUL was reported idempotent-success because duplicate handling occurred before source-epoch validation. Stored readiness was not mutated, but this violated the stronger exact-rejected-no-op callback rule. Revision moved stage-specific source freshness validation before duplicate/idempotent handling. Re-run with seed 53255 over 100000 randomized streams: 0 invariant violations, 107689 accepted exact-current receipts, 321021 rejected stale/proxy receipts, PASS. This falsification/revision is a research MODEL result, not a newly observed production runtime defect. Required production properties remain structural exact-current identity, distinct ordered immutable FIRST_PRESENTED -> FIRST_USEFUL -> FIRST_INTERACTIVE, metadata-only native target/focus evidence, fail-closed source-loss/restart/reversal/terminal/remap/resource replacement, proxy non-authority, and explicitly non-success degraded timeout.
